bias.zh: 下降趋势 · 收复 $131–134，测试 5 日均线

read.en: The Nasdaq ADS rose 5.5% on Nov 9 to $134.38, trading between $125.83 and $135.60; there is no 100-day yet (86 sessions). It closed just below the falling 5-day ($135.9) and under the falling 10-day ($144.85) and 30-day ($156.33) averages. MACD has been below its signal since Nov 5 and below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 5 ($164.32), and RSI is 41.
read.zh: 纳斯达克 ADS 11月9日上涨 5.5%，收于 $134.38，盘中区间 $125.83–135.60；上市仅 86 个交易日，尚无 100 日均线。收盘略低于下行的 5 日均线（$135.9），并位于下行的 10 日（$144.85）和 30 日均线（$156.33）下方。MACD 自 11月5日起位于信号线下方且在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 11月5日起看空（$164.32），RSI 为 41。

read.en: The close cleared the $130.8–133.8 resistance (Oct 22 and Aug 7 lows, Nov 6 high), now support, and stopped at the 5-day. Resistance is $135.6–135.9 (Nov 9 high, 5-day), then $141.2 (Nov 4 low) and $144.9 (10-day). Support is $130.8–133.8, then $124.8–125.8 (Jul 29 and Nov 9 lows) and $122.2. A close above $135.9 would target $141.2; below $130.8, $125.

bias.en: Breakdown · steadied above ₩1,089,000, under the October low
bias.zh: 破位 · 企稳于 ₩1,089,000 上方，仍低于 10 月低点

read.en: SK hynix's latest Seoul close is ₩1,136,000, little changed from ₩1,132,000 in the previous read; the latest full session ranged ₩1,116,000–1,193,000. It is below the falling 5-day (₩1,212,800), 10-day (₩1,336,500), 30-day (₩1,447,867) and 100-day (₩1,774,630) and the rising 200-day (₩1,511,640) averages. MACD has been below its signal since Nov 5 and below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 4 (₩1,541,745), and RSI is 33.
read.zh: SK 海力士首尔最新收盘价为 ₩1,136,000，与上次解读的 ₩1,132,000 基本持平；最近一个完整交易日区间为 ₩1,116,000–1,193,000。股价位于下行的 5 日（₩1,212,800）、10 日（₩1,336,500）、30 日（₩1,447,867）和 100 日均线（₩1,774,630）以及上行的 200 日均线（₩1,511,640）下方。MACD 自 11月5日起位于信号线下方且在零轴下方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月4日起看空（₩1,541,745），RSI 为 33。

read.en: No level changed: the latest low (₩1,116,000) held above the ₩1,089,000 low, and the ₩1,193,000 high stayed under the 5-day. Resistance is ₩1,171,000 (Oct 22 low), then ₩1,193,000–1,212,800 (latest high, Oct 21 low, 5-day) and ₩1,246,000–1,250,000. Support is ₩1,116,000, then ₩1,089,000 and ₩1,024,000–1,040,000 (April lows). A close above ₩1,171,000 would target ₩1.21 million; below ₩1,089,000, ₩1.03 million.

s.zh: 11月5日低点，4 月中旬以来最低
